verdict.rationale: ScrapingBee is a hosted scraping API. Whether its source is available under an open license is a fair question for this kind of product, but the pack has no evidence of an open-source license or a public source release for the service. The GitHub-hosted CLI is a client tool with no license stated, so it does not show the product's source is openly licensed.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
